message.reasoning_content:
Write pure C# class VisualColorTransition using existing Vec (X/Y/Z, +,-, *double, Length) for RGB. Public Vec Step(Vec target,double dt). First call snaps to initial target. On target change restart linear 1.5 sec transition from current color. Subsequent same target calls do not restart. Clamp negative dt to0 and progress<=1. New target midfade continues from current without jump. System.Math only, no tools, code only.

We need code only. Provide class.

Implement private bool initialized? Vec current, target, start; double elapsed; double duration=1.5.

Step method:
if not initialized: current = target; start=current; target stored? Actually snap. Set initialized true; elapsed=0; return current.

Check if target diff length >1e-9 compared to stored target? Need detect change. If target != previous target: start = current; elapsed=0; store target.

Then elapsed += dt clamped. progress = min(elapsed/duration,1). current = start + (target - start)*progress.

Return current.

Ensure clamp negative dt.

Output code.
